title: Norm bound for low-degree truncation
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $q$ satisfy $1<q\le 2$. The uniform $L^q$ norm of the Fourier truncation of $f$ to degrees at most $k$ is at most $(1/\sqrt{q-1})^k$ times the uniform $L^q$ norm of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
